def mvcc.chanRegW (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (w : Loc) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ γw r fcs, mvcc.watcherMeta γ w γw ∗ mvcc.watcherFixed w r fcs ∗ mvcc.chanRegTok γc r.id r γw.fg γw.lo)

def mvcc.complW (γw : mvcc.WatcherNames) (ql : Qp) (CS : IProp GF) (covl : List Loc) (id rev : w64)
    (evm : List mvcc.EvM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(□
      ∀ L,
        ⌜id = W64 (-1)⌝ -∗
          CS -∗
            ghostVar γw.wc.regl (Qp.half 1) L -∗
              dghostVar γw.live (DFrac.own ql) true -∗
                CS ∗
                  ghostVar γw.wc.regl (Qp.half 1) L ∗
                    dghostVar γw.live (DFrac.own ql) true ∗
                      mvcc.progFact γw.wc.prog ∗
                        (□ ∀ w, ⌜w ∈ L⌝ -∗ ⌜w ∈ covl⌝ ∨ mvcc.rsnW γw.wc w) ∗ ⌜1 ≤ sint.Z rev ∧ evm = []⌝)

def mvcc.chanSentLb (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (l : List mvcc.RespM) : IProp GF :=
  monoListLbOwn γc.sentl l

theorem mvcc.isWatchableStore_persistent (s st : Loc) (γ : mvcc.WsNames) : Persistent
    (mvcc.isWatchableStore s st γ)

theorem mvcc.wlogQ_auth_agree (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (q q' : Qp) (L C : mvcc.Log) : mvcc.wlogQ γ q L ∗
    mvcc.idxLogAuth γ.st.idx q' C ⊢ ⌜C = L⌝

def mvcc.evLog (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (L : mvcc.Log) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(mvcc.idxSealed γ.idx L ∗ mvcc.certOk γ L ∗ ⌜mvcc.logCh L < 2 ^ 48⌝ ∗ mvcc.api.nlLb γ.api L)

theorem mvcc.watcherMeta_agree (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (w : Loc) (γw γw' : mvcc.WatcherNames) : ⊢
    mvcc.watcherMeta γ w γw -∗ mvcc.watcherMeta γ w γw' -∗ ⌜γw = γw'⌝

theorem mvcc.evsWf_pos (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (r : mvcc.WatchRange) (lo : Nat) (evs : List mvcc.EvM) (d
    : Nat) : mvcc.evsWf γ r lo evs d ⊢ ⌜∀ (ev : mvcc.EvM), ev ∈ evs → mvcc.evPos ev⌝

def mvcc.WatcherNames.countable : Pos.Countable mvcc.WatcherNames :=
  Pos.Countable.ofInjective
    (fun g =>
      Pos.Countable.encode
        (g.evs, g.live, g.wc.ch.stateName, g.wc.ch.offerLockName, g.wc.ch.offerParkedPropName,
          g.wc.ch.offerParkedPredName, g.wc.ch.offerContinuationName, g.wc.ch.chanCap, g.wc.recv, g.wc.regl, g.wc.reg,
          g.wc.ids, g.wc.prog, g.wc.sentl, g.wc.regi, g.wc.rsn, g.wc.aev, g.wc.ans, g.wc.arcv, g.wc.arx, g.wc.acl, g.lo,
          g.now, g.fg))
    mvcc.WatcherNames.countable._proof_1

def mvcc.WsState.countable : Pos.Countable mvcc.WsState :=
  Pos.Countable.ofInjective (fun σ => Pos.Countable.encode (σ.Lmu, σ.Ws, σ.Wu, σ.ST, σ.Wo, σ.M, σ.E, σ.vs, σ.vbs, σ.VB))
    mvcc.WsState.countable._proof_1

theorem mvcc.respRev_new (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (sent : List mvcc.RespM) (L :
    List Loc) (nl : Option (Qp × mvcc.Log)) (x : mvcc.RespM) (hnl : x.evs = [] → ∃ q Lx, nl = some
    (q, Lx) ∧ sint.Z x.rev + 1 = ↑(List.length Lx)) (hc : x.compactRev = W64 0) : mvcc.sentAuth γ γc
    sent L ∗ mvcc.notifiedLent γ nl ∗ mvcc.revApi γ x.rev ⊢ mvcc.sentAuth γ γc sent L ∗
    mvcc.notifiedLent γ nl ∗ mvcc.respRev γ sent x

def mvcc.filtersOk (fcs : GoSlice) : IProp GF :=

theorem mvcc.filtersOk_persistent (fcs : GoSlice) : Persistent (mvcc.filtersOk fcs)

theorem mvcc.sentAuth_revs (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (sent : List mvcc.RespM) (L
    : List Loc) (q : Qp) (Lx : mvcc.Log) (hLx : Lx ≠ []) : mvcc.sentAuth γ γc sent L ∗
    monoListAuthOwn γ.wlog q Lx ⊢ mvcc.sentAuth γ γc sent L ∗ monoListAuthOwn γ.wlog q Lx ∗ ⌜∀ (y :
    mvcc.RespM), y ∈ sent → y.evs = [] → sint.Z y.rev + 1 ≤ ↑(List.length Lx)⌝

theorem mvcc.chanRegAt_stream (γo : mvcc.WsStreamNames) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (w : Loc) (n :
    Nat) (h : γo.regi = γc.regi) : mvcc.chanRegAt γc w n ⊣⊢ mvcc.streamRegAt γo w n

def mvcc.sentAuth (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (sent : List mvcc.RespM) (L : List
    Loc) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(monoListAuthOwn γc.sentl 1 sent ∗
      ∃ RI,
        ghostMapAuth γc.regi 1 RI ∗
          ⌜(∀ (w : Loc), (RI !! w).isSome = true → w ∈ L) ∧
                (∀ (w : Loc) (n : Nat), RI !! w = some n → n ≤ sent.length) ∧ mvcc.regsOk RI sent ∧ mvcc.idxOk sent⌝ ∗
            □ [∗list] k ↦ x ∈ sent, mvcc.respCov γ γc (List.take k sent) x)

theorem mvcc.streamRegAt_persistent (γo : mvcc.WsStreamNames) (w : Loc) (n : Nat) : Persistent
    (mvcc.streamRegAt γo w n)

theorem mvcc.wlogQ_cert_prefix (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (q : Qp) (L C : mvcc.Log) : mvcc.wlogQ γ q L ∗
    mvcc.idxCert γ.st.idx C ⊢ ⌜C <+: L⌝

theorem mvcc.sentAuth_reg_regs (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (sent : List
    mvcc.RespM) (L : List Loc) (w : Loc) (n : Nat) : mvcc.sentAuth γ γc sent L ∗ mvcc.chanRegAt γc w
    n ⊢ ⌜∀ (k : Nat) (x : mvcc.RespM), n ≤ k → sent[k]? = some x → x.id = W64 (-1) → w ∈ x.regs⌝

def mvcc.watchToks (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (k : Nat) : IProp GF :=
  ownToks γ.wt k

def mvcc.isWatchableStore (s st : Loc) (γ : mvcc.WsNames) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ vc stc rv γv,
      "#Hst" ∷
          typedPointsto
            (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.watchableStore go!"store" s)
            st DFrac.discard ∗
        "#Hs" ∷ mvcc.isStore st γ.st ∗
          "#Hrv" ∷
              typedPointsto
                (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store
                  go!"ReadView" st)
                (interface.mkOk go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.readView.ty.PointerType (intoVal rv))
                DFrac.discard ∗
            "#Hrvkv" ∷
                typedPointsto (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.readView go!"kv" rv)
                  (interface.mkOk go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.watchableStore.ty.PointerType (intoVal s))
                  DFrac.discard ∗
              ("#HwvW" ∷
                  ∃ wv,
                    typedPointsto
                        (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store
                          go!"WriteView" st)
                        (interface.mkOk go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.writeView.ty.PointerType (intoVal wv))
                        DFrac.discard ∗
                      typedPointsto (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.writeView go!"kv" wv)
                        (interface.mkOk go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.watchableStore.ty.PointerType (intoVal s))
                        DFrac.discard) ∗
                "#Hmu" ∷ sync.isRWMutexGuard (mvcc.wsMuAddr s) (mvcc.watchStoreInv s γ) ∗
                  "#Hvc" ∷
                      typedPointsto
                        (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.watchableStore
                          go!"victimc" s)
                        vc DFrac.discard ∗
                    ("#Hvcb" ∷ isChanBag γv vc fun x => iprop(True)) ∗
                      "#Hstopc" ∷
                          typedPointsto
                            (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.watchableStore
                              go!"stopc" s)
                            stc DFrac.discard ∗
                        "#Hstop" ∷ mvcc.isStopChan stc ∗ "#Hfrz" ∷ mvcc.wsFrozenM γ.st ∗ "%Hwq" ∷ ⌜γ.st.watchQ = true⌝)

def mvcc.covFact (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (pre : List mvcc.RespM) (w' : Loc)
    (rev : w64) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ γw r fcs D L d,
      mvcc.watcherMeta γ w' γw ∗
        ⌜γw.wc = γc⌝ ∗
          mvcc.watcherFixed w' r fcs ∗
            mvcc.evLog γ.st L ∗
              (□
                  ∀ dl,
                    ⌜dl ∈ D⌝ -∗
                      ∃ fs,
                        mvcc.filtersImpl fcs fs ∗ mvcc.api.savedFilters γw.fg fs ∗ ⌜dl.snd = mvcc.filtered fs dl.fst⌝) ∗
                (⌜(List.map Prod.fst D).flatten = mvcc.watchEvents L r γw.lo d⌝ ∨ mvcc.doomed γ γw.lo) ∗
                  ⌜List.map mvcc.RespM.evs (List.filter (fun y => decide (y.w = w')) pre) =
                        List.map Prod.snd (List.filter mvcc.Deliv.sent D) ∧
                      (d ≤ List.length L ∨ d ≤ γw.lo) ∧
                        sint.Z rev + 1 ≤ ↑d ∧
                          (↑d ≤ sint.Z rev + 1 ∨ d ≤ γw.lo) ∧ mvcc.startLo r γw.lo ∧ ↑γw.lo ≤ sint.Z rev + 1⌝)

theorem mvcc.wsSlot_nlLb (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (q : Qp) (Lmu : mvcc.Log) : mvcc.wsSlot γ q Lmu ⊢
    mvcc.wsSlot γ q Lmu ∗ mvcc.api.nlLb γ.st.api Lmu

def mvcc.WsState.settled (σ : mvcc.WsState) : Prop :=
  σ.syncedBelow (List.length σ.Lmu) ∧ σ.vicBelow (List.length σ.Lmu)

def mvcc.covPre (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (rev : w64) (cs : List mvcc.CovArg) :
    IProp GF :=
  [∗list] c ∈ cs, mvcc.covEntry γ γc rev c

def mvcc.revApi (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (rev : w64) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ N, mvcc.api.nlLb γ.st.api N ∗ ⌜sint.nat rev < List.length N⌝)

def mvcc.streamSentLb (γo : mvcc.WsStreamNames) (l : List mvcc.RespM) : IProp GF :=
  monoListLbOwn γo.sentl l

def mvcc.rdIs (rd : GoFunc) (s st : Loc) (γ : mvcc.WsNames) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜rd ≠ func.nil⌝ ∗
      □
        ∀ P Pre Q f G,
          □
            ∀ Φ,
              mvcc.storeReader st γ.st ∗
                  mvcc.storeWT γ.st ∗
                    mvcc.hookIs γ.st P f ∗
                      Pre ∗
                        (□ □ ∀ Φ, P ∗ Pre -∗ ▷ (Q -∗ Φ (intoVal ())) -∗ WP (f (intoVal ())) {{ Φ }}) ∗
                          G ∗ □ (mvcc.slotF γ.st ∗ G -∗ False) -∗
                (▷
                    ∀ tw trace,
                      (∃ L crev, mvcc.isWatchTxnWrite tw s st γ trace L [] (W64 0) (W64 0) (W64 0) crev) ∗
                          Q ∗ mvcc.hookIs γ.st P f ∗ G -∗
                        Φ
                          (intoVal
                            (interface.mkOk go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.watchableStoreTxnWrite.ty.PointerType
                              (intoVal tw)))) -∗
                  WP ((intoVal rd) (intoVal ())) {{ Φ }})

theorem mvcc.slotX_crevLb (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (q : Qp) (L : mvcc.Log) (c : Int) : mvcc.slotX γ q L
    c ⊢ mvcc.slotX γ q L c ∗ mvcc.api.crevAtLeast γ.api c

def mvcc.storeWatchParams (s st : Loc) (γ : mvcc.WsNames) : mvcc.WatchParams GF :=
  {
    IW := fun w =>
      iprop(∃ γw r fcs,
          mvcc.watcherMeta γ w γw ∗
            mvcc.watcherFixed w r fcs ∗
              ⌜0 ≤ sint.Z r.startRev ∧ r.id ≠ W64 (-1)⌝ ∗ ⌜γw.now = false → ↑γw.lo ≤ sint.Z r.startRev⌝),
    WC := fun w => iprop(∃ γw, mvcc.watcherMeta γ w γw ∗ mvcc.cancelled γw), C := fun x => iprop(True),
    FI := mvcc.filtersImpl, RegCb := mvcc.regCb γ, RevCb := mvcc.readCb γ.st,
    CR := fun ch γc L =>
      iprop(isChan ch γc.ch go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.WatchResponse ∗
          inv mvcc.watchN (mvcc.watchChanInv γ ch γc) ∗ ghostVar γc.regl (Qp.half 1) L),
    R := mvcc.watchReader s st γ, T := mvcc.watchTok γ, IWF := mvcc.watcherIs γ,
    OC := fun w γc => iprop(∃ γw, mvcc.watcherMeta γ w γw ∗ ⌜γw.wc = γc⌝),
    WS := fun w => iprop(∃ γw, mvcc.watcherMeta γ w γw), IW_pers := ⋯, WC_pers := ⋯, C_pers := ⋯, FI_pers := ⋯,
    IWF_pers := ⋯, OC_pers := ⋯, WS_pers := ⋯ }

def mvcc.relAuth (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (q : Qp) (Lmu : mvcc.Log) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(monoNatAuthOwn γ.rel q (List.length Lmu) ∗ mvcc.wsSlot γ q Lmu)

theorem mvcc.chanRegFact_persistent (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (w : Loc) : Persistent
    (mvcc.chanRegFact γc w)

structure mvcc.WsNames : Type where
  st : mvcc.StoreNames
  wmeta : GName
  wlog : GName
  wst : GName
  wt : GName
  rel : GName
  tag : GName

def mvcc.filtersImpl (fcs : GoSlice) (fs : List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ fps,
      ownSlice fcs fps DFrac.discard ∗ ⌜fps.length = fs.length⌝ ∗ [∗list] x ∈ fps.zip fs, mvcc.filterSpec x.fst x.snd)

theorem mvcc.sentAuth_reg_regsL (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (sent : List
    mvcc.RespM) (L : List Loc) (ps : List (Loc × Nat)) : (mvcc.sentAuth γ γc sent L ∗ □ [∗list] p ∈
    ps, mvcc.chanRegAt γc p.fst p.snd) ⊢ ⌜∀ (p : Loc × Nat), p ∈ ps → ∀ (k : Nat) (x : mvcc.RespM),
    p.snd ≤ k → sent[k]? = some x → x.id = W64 (-1) → p.fst ∈ x.regs⌝

theorem mvcc.popFacts_synced (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (σ : mvcc.WsState) (k : Loc) (r : mvcc.WatchRange)
    (lo : Nat) (st : mvcc.WatcherSt) (evsw : List mvcc.EvM) (d : Nat) (h : (σ.Ws !! k).isSome =
    true) : mvcc.popFacts γ σ k r lo st evsw d = iprop(⌜↑lo ≤ sint.Z st.minRev ∧ sint.Z st.minRev ≤
    ↑d⌝ ∗ mvcc.evsWf γ r lo evsw d ∗ mvcc.evsWf γ r lo evsw (sint.nat st.minRev))

theorem mvcc.relAuth_of_eq (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (q : Qp) (L1 L2 : mvcc.Log) (h : L1 = L2) :
    mvcc.relAuth γ q L1 ⊢ mvcc.relAuth γ q L2

theorem mvcc.evLog_of_sealed (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (L : mvcc.Log) (hrb : receiptBound GF ≤ 2 ^ 48) :
    mvcc.idxSealed γ.idx L ∗ mvcc.certOk γ L ∗ mvcc.api.nlLb γ.api L ⊢ mvcc.evLog γ L

theorem mvcc.respCov_rev (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (pre : List mvcc.RespM) (x :
    mvcc.RespM) : mvcc.respCov γ γc pre x ⊢ mvcc.revLbOf γ x

def mvcc.covEntry (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (rev : w64) (c : mvcc.CovArg) :
    IProp GF :=
  iprop(mvcc.watcherMeta γ c.w c.γw ∗
      ⌜c.γw.wc = γc⌝ ∗
        mvcc.watcherFixed c.w c.r c.fcs ∗
          monoListLbOwn c.γw.evs c.evsw ∗
            mvcc.evsWf γ c.r c.γw.lo c.evsw c.d ∗
              ⌜sint.Z rev + 1 ≤ ↑c.d ∧ (↑c.d ≤ sint.Z rev + 1 ∨ c.d ≤ c.γw.lo) ∧ ↑c.γw.lo ≤ sint.Z rev + 1⌝ ∗
                c.w ↪[γc.reg]□ ())

theorem mvcc.wsWatchFrozen_persistent (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (σ : mvcc.WsState) : Persistent
    (mvcc.wsWatchFrozen γ σ)

theorem mvcc.streamSentLb_persistent (γo : mvcc.WsStreamNames) (l : List mvcc.RespM) : Persistent
    (mvcc.streamSentLb γo l)

def mvcc.watchN : Namespace :=
  (nroot.@"mvcc").@"watch"

def mvcc.outRes (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (σ : mvcc.WsState) (w : Loc) (st : mvcc.WatcherSt) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ γw r fcs, ⌜σ.M !! w = some γw⌝ ∗ mvcc.watcherMeta γ w γw ∗ mvcc.watcherFixed w r fcs)

def mvcc.apiRecvLb (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (ch : Loc) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (rs : List mvcc.RespM) :
    IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ l dec,
      mvcc.api.logTok (mvcc.wsAbsOf γ ch γc) l dec ∗
        monoNatLbOwn (mvcc.wsAbsOf γ ch γc).ns (mvcc.api.sent.nsCount l) ∗
          ⌜List.map mvcc.RespM.toW rs <+: mvcc.api.sent.sendsOf l⌝)

def mvcc.WsState.syncedAbove (σ : mvcc.WsState) (N : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ (w : Loc) (γw : mvcc.WatcherNames) (ed : List mvcc.EvM × Nat),
    (σ.Ws !! w).isSome = true → σ.M !! w = some γw → σ.E !! w = some ed → max γw.lo N ≤ ed.snd

theorem mvcc.isWatchableStore_frozen (s st : Loc) (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (h : γ.st.cm = false) :
    mvcc.isWatchableStore s st γ ⊢ mvcc.crevFrozen γ.st

def mvcc.respCov (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (pre : List mvcc.RespM) (x :
    mvcc.RespM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop((□ ∀ w', ⌜w' ∈ x.cov⌝ -∗ mvcc.covFact γ γc pre w' x.rev) ∗
      mvcc.respCompl γc x ∗ ⌜x.evs = [] → x.compactRev = W64 0 → x.w ∈ x.cov⌝ ∗ mvcc.respRev γ pre x)

theorem mvcc.revLbs_le (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (q : Qp) (Lx : mvcc.Log) (hLx : Lx ≠ []) (l : List
    mvcc.RespM) : (monoListAuthOwn γ.wlog q Lx ∗ □ [∗list] y ∈ l, mvcc.revLbOf γ y) ⊢ ⌜∀ (y :
    mvcc.RespM), y ∈ l → y.evs = [] → sint.Z y.rev + 1 ≤ ↑(List.length Lx)⌝

def mvcc.watchBudget (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (q : Qp) (M : GMap Loc mvcc.WatcherNames) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ n, ownTokAuthDfrac γ.wt (DFrac.own q) n ∗ ⌜M.size + n + 3 ≤ 2 ^ 63⌝)

structure mvcc.WsOk (σ : mvcc.WsState) : Prop where
  ws_wu : σ.Wu !! w = none
  ws_v : σ.victimOf w = none
  wu_v : σ.victimOf w = none
  v_one : i = j
  live_st : (σ.ST !! w).isSome = true
  live_e : (σ.E !! w).isSome = true ↔ σ.live w
  st_m : (σ.M !! w).isSome = true
  wo_m : (σ.M !! w).isSome = true
  m_st : (σ.ST !! w).isSome = true ∨ (σ.Wo !! w).isSome = true
  wo_st : σ.ST !! w = none
  wo_live : ¬σ.live w
  st_flags : (st.compacted = true → σ.Ws !! w = none ∧ σ.victimOf w = none) ∧
  (σ.live w → (st.victim = true ↔ (σ.victimOf w).isSome = true)) ∧ (st.ch = null ↔ ¬σ.live w)
  wo_flags : st.compacted = false ∧ st.victim = true ∧ st.ch ≠ null
  synced_d : max γw.lo (List.length σ.Lmu) ≤ ed.snd

def mvcc.WsState.syncedBelow (σ : mvcc.WsState) (N : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ (w : Loc) (γw : mvcc.WatcherNames) (ed : List mvcc.EvM × Nat),
    (σ.Ws !! w).isSome = true → σ.M !! w = some γw → σ.E !! w = some ed → ed.snd ≤ N ∨ ed.snd ≤ γw.lo

theorem mvcc.isWatchableStore_isStore (s st : Loc) (γ : mvcc.WsNames) : mvcc.isWatchableStore s st γ
    ⊢ mvcc.isStore st γ.st

theorem mvcc.notifiedLb_persistent (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (L : mvcc.Log) : Persistent (mvcc.notifiedLb γ
    L)

theorem mvcc.covAuth_nil (q : Qp) : ⊢ mvcc.covAuth q []

def mvcc.noDupKeys (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(□ ∀ log, mvcc.evLog γ log ={⊤}=∗ ⌜mvcc.oneChangePerKey log⌝)

theorem mvcc.respRev_persistent (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (pre : List mvcc.RespM) (x : mvcc.RespM) :
    Persistent (mvcc.respRev γ pre x)

theorem mvcc.respIs_persistent (v : go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.WatchResponse) (r :
    mvcc.RespM) : Persistent (mvcc.respIs v r)

def mvcc.startLo (r : mvcc.WatchRange) (lo : Nat) : Prop :=
  r.startRev ≠ W64 0 → lo = (sint.Z r.startRev).toNat

theorem mvcc.watchBudget_spend (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (M : GMap Loc mvcc.WatcherNames) (w : Loc) (γw :
    mvcc.WatcherNames) (hM : M !! w = none) : mvcc.watchBudget γ 1 M ∗ mvcc.watchTok γ ⊢ |==>
    mvcc.watchBudget γ 1 <[w := γw]>M

def mvcc.respsIs (vs : List go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.WatchResponse) (rs : List
    mvcc.RespM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜vs.length = rs.length⌝ ∗ □ ∀ i v r, ⌜vs[i]? = some v⌝ -∗ ⌜rs[i]? = some r⌝ -∗ mvcc.respIs v r)

theorem mvcc.regWit_reg (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (l : List mvcc.api.sent.SEv) (w : Loc) (rg :
    mvcc.WatchRange) (fcs : GoSlice) (fg : GName) (lo : Nat) : mvcc.regWit γc l ∗ w ↪[γc.reg]□ () ∗
    mvcc.watcherFixed w rg fcs ⊢ mvcc.regWit γc (l ++ [mvcc.api.sent.SEv.reg rg.id rg fg lo])

def mvcc.WatcherSt.countable : Pos.Countable mvcc.WatcherSt :=
  Pos.Countable.ofInjective (fun r => Pos.Countable.encode (r.minRev, r.victim, r.compacted, r.restore, r.ch))
    mvcc.WatcherSt.countable._proof_1

def mvcc.watcherIs (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (w : Loc) (r : mvcc.WatchRange) (fcs : GoSlice) (lo : Nat) :
    IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ γw C,
      mvcc.watcherMeta γ w γw ∗
        mvcc.watcherFixed w r fcs ∗
          mvcc.idxCert γ.st.idx C ∗
            (∃ n, mvcc.chanRegAt γw.wc w n) ∗
              ⌜γw.lo = lo ∧ lo = if r.startRev = W64 0 then List.length C else (sint.Z r.startRev).toNat⌝)

theorem mvcc.watchTokPool_take (γ : mvcc.WsNames) : ⊢ mvcc.watchTokPool γ -∗ ⧗1 ={⊤}=∗ mvcc.watchTok
    γ

theorem mvcc.chanApi_recv (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (ch : Loc) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (sent recv : List
    mvcc.RespM) (r : mvcc.RespM) (hp : recv ++ [r] <+: sent) : ⊢ mvcc.chanApi γ ch γc sent recv ∗
    ghostVar γc.arcv (Qp.half 1) (List.map mvcc.RespM.toW recv) ==∗ mvcc.chanApi γ ch γc sent (recv
    ++ [r]) ∗ ghostVar γc.arcv (Qp.half 1) (List.map mvcc.RespM.toW (recv ++ [r])) ∗ mvcc.apiRecvLb
    γ ch γc (recv ++ [r])

def mvcc.wlogQ (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (q : Qp) (L : mvcc.Log) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(monoListAuthOwn γ.wlog q L ∗ mvcc.idxLogAuth γ.st.idx q.half.half L)

theorem mvcc.monoList_halves (g : GName) (L : mvcc.Log) : monoListAuthOwn g 1 L ⊣⊢ monoListAuthOwn g
    (Qp.half 1) L ∗ monoListAuthOwn g (Qp.half 1) L

theorem mvcc.watcherIs_persistent (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (w : Loc) (r : mvcc.WatchRange) (fcs : GoSlice)
    (lo : Nat) : Persistent (mvcc.watcherIs γ w r fcs lo)

theorem mvcc.popFacts_persistent (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (σ : mvcc.WsState) (w : Loc) (r :
    mvcc.WatchRange) (lo : Nat) (st : mvcc.WatcherSt) (evsw : List mvcc.EvM) (d : Nat) : Persistent
    (mvcc.popFacts γ σ w r lo st evsw d)

theorem mvcc.noCompactor_of_new (s st : Loc) (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (E : CoPset) : ⊢
    mvcc.isWatchableStore s st γ ∗ mvcc.crevRightM γ.st ={E}=∗ mvcc.noCompactor γ.st

theorem mvcc.popFacts_victim (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (σ : mvcc.WsState) (k : Loc) (r : mvcc.WatchRange)
    (lo : Nat) (st : mvcc.WatcherSt) (evsw : List mvcc.EvM) (d : Nat) (B : mvcc.EventBatch) (h1 :
    (σ.Ws !! k).isSome = false) (h2 : (σ.Wu !! k).isSome = false) (h3 : σ.victimOf k = some B) :
    mvcc.popFacts γ σ k r lo st evsw d = iprop(⌜↑lo ≤ sint.Z st.minRev ∧ d = sint.nat st.minRev ∧
    mvcc.victimBatchOk lo st B ∧ B.evs ≠ []⌝ ∗ mvcc.evsWf γ r lo (evsw ++ B.evs) d)

theorem mvcc.sentAuth_register (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (sent : List
    mvcc.RespM) (L : List Loc) (w : Loc) (hw : ¬w ∈ L) : ⊢ mvcc.sentAuth γ γc sent L ==∗
    mvcc.sentAuth γ γc sent (w :: L) ∗ mvcc.chanRegAt γc w sent.length

theorem mvcc.watcherMeta_persistent (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (w : Loc) (γw : mvcc.WatcherNames) :
    Persistent (mvcc.watcherMeta γ w γw)

theorem mvcc.cov_one (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (closed : Bool) (sent : List
    mvcc.RespM) (L : List Loc) (rev : w64) (q : Qp) (c : mvcc.CovArg) : (mvcc.covEntry γ γc rev c ∗
    monoListAuthOwn c.γw.evs q c.evsw ∗ ghostMapAuth γc.reg 1 (mvcc.regMap L) ∗ [∗list] w ∈ L,
    mvcc.chanWatcher γ γc closed sent w) ⊢ monoListAuthOwn c.γw.evs q c.evsw ∗ ghostMapAuth γc.reg 1
    (mvcc.regMap L) ∗ ([∗list] w ∈ L, mvcc.chanWatcher γ γc closed sent w) ∗ mvcc.covFact γ γc sent
    c.w rev

theorem mvcc.evsWf_ne_lo (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (r : mvcc.WatchRange) (lo : Nat) (evs : List mvcc.EvM)
    (d : Nat) : mvcc.evsWf γ r lo evs d ⊢ ⌜evs ≠ [] → lo < d⌝

theorem mvcc.evsWf_exact (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (r : mvcc.WatchRange) (lo : Nat) (evs : List mvcc.EvM)
    (d : Nat) (L : mvcc.Log) (h : evs = mvcc.watchEvents L r lo d ∧ (d ≤ List.length L ∨ d ≤ lo)) :
    mvcc.evLog γ.st L ∗ mvcc.relLb γ (List.length L) ⊢ mvcc.evsWf γ r lo evs d

theorem mvcc.apiRecvLb_persistent (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (ch : Loc) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (rs :
    List mvcc.RespM) : Persistent (mvcc.apiRecvLb γ ch γc rs)

theorem mvcc.sentAuth_snoc (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (sent : List mvcc.RespM) (L
    : List Loc) (x : mvcc.RespM) (hx : x.id = W64 (-1) → ∀ (w : Loc), w ∈ L → w ∈ x.regs) (hxi :
    x.idx = sent.length) : ⊢ mvcc.sentAuth γ γc sent L -∗ mvcc.respCov γ γc sent x ==∗ mvcc.sentAuth
    γ γc (sent ++ [x]) L

theorem mvcc.WsOk.wu_size {σ : mvcc.WsState} (h : mvcc.WsOk σ) : σ.Wu.size ≤ σ.M.size

theorem mvcc.respsIs_persistent (vs : List go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.WatchResponse) (rs
    : List mvcc.RespM) : Persistent (mvcc.respsIs vs rs)

theorem mvcc.isWatchableStore_readView (s st : Loc) (γ : mvcc.WsNames) : mvcc.isWatchableStore s st
    γ ⊢ ∃ rv, typedPointsto (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store
    go!"ReadView" st) (interface.mkOk go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.readView.ty.PointerType
    (intoVal rv)) DFrac.discard ∗ mvcc.isReadView rv st γ.st

theorem mvcc.watchTokPool_alloc (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (E : CoPset) (h : receiptBound GF ≤ 2 ^ 63 - 2) :
    mvcc.watchToks γ (2 ^ 63 - 3) ⊢ |={E}=> mvcc.watchTokPool γ

def mvcc.wsMuAddr [GoSemanticsFunctions] (s : Loc) : Loc :=
  structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.watchableStore go!"mu" s

def mvcc.watcherChan (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (w : Loc) (γw : mvcc.WatcherNames) (ch : Loc) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(isChan ch γw.wc.ch go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.WatchResponse ∗
      inv mvcc.watchN (mvcc.watchChanInv γ ch γw.wc) ∗ w ↪[γw.wc.reg]□ ())

def mvcc.streamRegAt (γo : mvcc.WsStreamNames) (w : Loc) (n : Nat) : IProp GF :=
  w ↪[γo.regi]□ n

def mvcc.watchTokPool (γ : mvcc.WsNames) : IProp GF :=
  inv mvcc.watchTokN iprop(∃ a n, ⧗a ∗ ownToks γ.wt n ∗ ⌜receiptBound GF ≤ a + n + 1⌝)

theorem mvcc.noDupKeys_persistent (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : Persistent (mvcc.noDupKeys γ)

def mvcc.victimBatchOk (lo : Nat) (st : mvcc.WatcherSt) (B : mvcc.EventBatch) : Prop :=
  (B.moreRev ≠ W64 0 → B.moreRev = st.minRev) ∧
    ∀ (ev : mvcc.EvM), ev ∈ B.evs → ↑lo ≤ sint.Z ev.kv.modRev ∧ sint.Z ev.kv.modRev < sint.Z st.minRev

theorem mvcc.cancelled_persistent (γw : mvcc.WatcherNames) : Persistent (mvcc.cancelled γw)

theorem mvcc.notifiedLent_none (γ : mvcc.WsNames) : ⊢ mvcc.notifiedLent γ none

theorem mvcc.evLog_pos (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (L : mvcc.Log) : mvcc.evLog γ L ⊢ ⌜∀ (r :
    mvcc.WatchRange) (lo hi : Nat) (ev : mvcc.EvM), ev ∈ mvcc.watchEvents L r lo hi → mvcc.evPos ev⌝

theorem mvcc.respCompl_persistent (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (x : mvcc.RespM) : Persistent
    (mvcc.respCompl γc x)

def mvcc.Deliv : Type :=
  List mvcc.EvM × List mvcc.EvM

def mvcc.watcherFilters (γw : mvcc.WatcherNames) (fcs : GoSlice) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ fs, mvcc.filtersImpl fcs fs ∗ mvcc.api.savedFilters γw.fg fs)

def mvcc.WsState.victimOf (σ : mvcc.WsState) (w : Loc) : Option mvcc.EventBatch :=
  List.findSome? (fun x => x !! w) σ.VB

def mvcc.revLbOf (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (y : mvcc.RespM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜y.evs ≠ []⌝ ∨
      (∃ L, mvcc.notifiedLb γ L ∗ ⌜sint.Z y.rev + 1 = ↑(List.length L)⌝) ∨ ⌜y.compactRev ≠ W64 0 ∧ y.rev = W64 0⌝)

def mvcc.watchNoDup (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(mvcc.noCompactor γ ∨ mvcc.noDupKeys γ)

def mvcc.EventBatch.countable : Pos.Countable mvcc.EventBatch :=
  Pos.Countable.ofInjective (fun r => Pos.Countable.encode (r.evs, r.revs, r.moreRev)) mvcc.EventBatch.countable._proof_1

theorem mvcc.regWit_app (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (l : List mvcc.api.sent.SEv) (e :
    mvcc.api.sent.SEv) (he : ∀ (id : w64) (rg : mvcc.WatchRange) (fg : GName) (lo : Nat), e ≠
    mvcc.api.sent.SEv.reg id rg fg lo) : mvcc.regWit γc l ⊢ mvcc.regWit γc (l ++ [e])

theorem mvcc.sentAuth_cov (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (sent : List mvcc.RespM) (L
    : List Loc) (k : Nat) (x : mvcc.RespM) (hk : sent[k]? = some x) : mvcc.sentAuth γ γc sent L ⊢
    mvcc.sentAuth γ γc sent L ∗ mvcc.respCov γ γc (List.take k sent) x

theorem mvcc.covEntry_persistent (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (rev : w64) (c :
    mvcc.CovArg) : Persistent (mvcc.covEntry γ γc rev c)

theorem mvcc.isStore_rb (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : mvcc.isStore s γ ⊢ ⌜receiptBound GF ≤ 2 ^
    48⌝

theorem mvcc.gmap_size_le_of_dom {V V' : Type} (m1 : GMap Loc V) (m2 : GMap Loc V') (h : ∀ (k :
    Loc), (m1 !! k).isSome = true → (m2 !! k).isSome = true) : m1.size ≤ m2.size

theorem mvcc.covFact_persistent (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (pre : List
    mvcc.RespM) (w' : Loc) (rev : w64) : Persistent (mvcc.covFact γ γc pre w' rev)

theorem mvcc.chanSentLb_persistent (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (l : List mvcc.RespM) : Persistent
    (mvcc.chanSentLb γc l)

theorem mvcc.respCov_persistent (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (pre : List
    mvcc.RespM) (x : mvcc.RespM) : Persistent (mvcc.respCov γ γc pre x)

def mvcc.watchTokN : Namespace :=
  (nroot.@"mvcc").@"watchTok"

theorem mvcc.sentAuth_lb (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (sent : List mvcc.RespM) (L :
    List Loc) : mvcc.sentAuth γ γc sent L ⊢ mvcc.sentAuth γ γc sent L ∗ mvcc.chanSentLb γc sent

theorem mvcc.evLog_persistent (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (L : mvcc.Log) : Persistent (mvcc.evLog γ L)

def mvcc.cmpPermOf (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (x : mvcc.RespM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜x.compactRev = W64 0⌝ ∨ ⌜0 < sint.Z x.compactRev⌝ ∗ mvcc.cmpPerm γ (sint.Z x.compactRev))

theorem mvcc.sentAuth_reg_le (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (sent : List mvcc.RespM)
    (L : List Loc) (w : Loc) (n : Nat) : mvcc.sentAuth γ γc sent L ∗ mvcc.chanRegAt γc w n ⊢ ⌜n ≤
    sent.length⌝

def mvcc.respIs (v : go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.WatchResponse) (r : mvcc.RespM) : IProp
    GF :=
  iprop(⌜v.WatchID' = r.id ∧ v.Revision' = r.rev ∧ v.CompactRevision' = r.compactRev⌝ ∗
      ∃ ps,
        ownSlice v.Events' ps DFrac.discard ∗
          ⌜ps.length = r.evs.length⌝ ∗ [∗list] x ∈ ps.zip r.evs, mvcc.evIs x.fst x.snd)

theorem mvcc.evLog_sealed (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (L : mvcc.Log) : mvcc.evLog γ L ⊢ mvcc.idxSealed
    γ.idx L

def mvcc.wsAbsOf (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (ch : Loc) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) : mvcc.api.WsAbs :=
  { st := γ.st.api, ev := γc.aev, ns := γc.ans, rcv := γc.arcv, rx := γc.arx, ch := ch, chn := γc.ch, crecv := γc.recv,
    cl := γc.acl }

theorem mvcc.evsExactOr_mono (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (lo : Nat) {P Q : Prop} {e e' : List mvcc.EvM} {d d'
    : Nat} (h : P → Q) (hd : ((e ≠ [] → lo < d) ∧ ∀ (ev : mvcc.EvM), ev ∈ e → mvcc.evPos ev) → (e' ≠
    [] → lo < d') ∧ ∀ (ev : mvcc.EvM), ev ∈ e' → mvcc.evPos ev) : ⌜P⌝ ∨ mvcc.doomed γ lo ∗ ⌜(e ≠ []
    → lo < d) ∧ ∀ (ev : mvcc.EvM), ev ∈ e → mvcc.evPos ev⌝ ⊢ ⌜Q⌝ ∨ mvcc.doomed γ lo ∗ ⌜(e' ≠ [] → lo
    < d') ∧ ∀ (ev : mvcc.EvM), ev ∈ e' → mvcc.evPos ev⌝

theorem mvcc.watcherChan_persistent (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (w : Loc) (γw : mvcc.WatcherNames) (ch : Loc)
    : Persistent (mvcc.watcherChan γ w γw ch)

def mvcc.complWS (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (M : GMap w64 Loc) (CS : IProp GF) :
    IProp GF :=
  iprop(□
      ∀ L u γw ql,
        ⌜∃ id, M !! id = some u⌝ -∗
          mvcc.watcherMeta γ u γw -∗
            CS -∗
              ghostVar γc.regl (Qp.half 1) L -∗
                dghostVar γw.live (DFrac.own ql) true -∗
                  CS ∗
                    ghostVar γc.regl (Qp.half 1) L ∗
                      dghostVar γw.live (DFrac.own ql) true ∗
                        □ ∀ w, ⌜w ∈ L⌝ -∗ (∃ id, ⌜M !! id = some w⌝) ∨ mvcc.rsnW γc w)

def mvcc.WsState.unsRst (σ : mvcc.WsState) : Prop :=
  ∀ (w : Loc) (st : mvcc.WatcherSt),
    (σ.Wu !! w).isSome = true → σ.ST !! w = some st → sint.Z st.minRev < ↑(List.length σ.Lmu) ∨ st.restore = true

theorem mvcc.complWS_persistent (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (M : GMap w64 Loc) (CS
    : IProp GF) : Persistent (mvcc.complWS γ γc M CS)

def mvcc.doomed (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (lo : Nat) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ N c, mvcc.api.nlLb γ.st.api N ∗ mvcc.api.crevAtLeast γ.st.api c ∗ ⌜¬mvcc.api.onceUpTo N lo c⌝)

theorem mvcc.evLog_nil (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : ⊢ |==> mvcc.evLog γ []

def mvcc.WsState.vicBelow (σ : mvcc.WsState) (N : Nat) : Prop :=
  (∀ (w : Loc) (st : mvcc.WatcherSt), (σ.victimOf w).isSome = true → σ.ST !! w = some st → sint.Z st.minRev ≤ ↑N) ∧
    ∀ (w : Loc) (st : mvcc.WatcherSt), σ.Wo !! w = some st → sint.Z st.minRev ≤ ↑N

def mvcc.filterSpec (f : GoFunc) (p : mvcc.EvM → Bool) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(□ ∀ e ev, □ ∀ Φ, mvcc.evIs e ev -∗ (▷ ∀ b, ⌜b = p ev⌝ -∗ Φ (intoVal b)) -∗ WP ((intoVal f) (intoVal e)) {{ Φ }})

def mvcc.regsOk (RI : GMap Loc Nat) (sent : List mvcc.RespM) : Prop :=
  ∀ (w : Loc) (n k : Nat) (x : mvcc.RespM), RI !! w = some n → n ≤ k → sent[k]? = some x → x.id = W64 (-1) → w ∈ x.regs

theorem mvcc.filtersImpl_persistent (fcs : GoSlice) (fs : List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) : Persistent
    (mvcc.filtersImpl fcs fs)

def mvcc.respRev (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (pre : List mvcc.RespM) (x : mvcc.RespM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop((⌜x.evs ≠ []⌝ ∨
        (∃ L,
            mvcc.notifiedLb γ L ∗
              ⌜sint.Z x.rev + 1 = ↑(List.length L) ∧
                  ∀ (y : mvcc.RespM), y ∈ pre → y.evs = [] → sint.Z y.rev ≤ sint.Z x.rev⌝) ∨
          ⌜x.compactRev ≠ W64 0 ∧ x.rev = W64 0⌝) ∗
      mvcc.cmpPermOf γ x ∗ (⌜x.compactRev ≠ W64 0⌝ ∨ mvcc.revApi γ x.rev))

theorem mvcc.sentAuth_lb_valid (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (sent : List
    mvcc.RespM) (L : List Loc) (l : List mvcc.RespM) : mvcc.sentAuth γ γc sent L ∗ mvcc.chanSentLb
    γc l ⊢ mvcc.sentAuth γ γc sent L ∗ ⌜l <+: sent⌝

theorem mvcc.covPre_nil (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (rev : w64) : ⊢ mvcc.covPre γ
    γc rev []

theorem mvcc.watchEvents_ne_lo (L : mvcc.Log) (r : mvcc.WatchRange) (lo d : Nat) (h :
    mvcc.watchEvents L r lo d ≠ []) : lo < d

theorem mvcc.respCov_of_list (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (pre : List mvcc.RespM)
    (x : mvcc.RespM) (cs : List mvcc.CovArg) (hcov : x.cov = List.map mvcc.CovArg.w cs) (hown :
    x.evs = [] → x.w ∈ x.cov) : (□ [∗list] c ∈ cs, mvcc.covFact γ γc pre c.w x.rev) ∗ mvcc.respCompl
    γc x ∗ mvcc.respRev γ pre x ⊢ mvcc.respCov γ γc pre x

theorem mvcc.watcherFilters_persistent (γw : mvcc.WatcherNames) (fcs : GoSlice) : Persistent
    (mvcc.watcherFilters γw fcs)

structure mvcc.WatcherNames : Type where
  evs : GName
  live : GName
  wc : mvcc.WatchChanNames
  lo : Nat
  now : Bool
  fg : GName

theorem mvcc.complW_persistent (γw : mvcc.WatcherNames) (ql : Qp) (CS : IProp GF) (covl : List Loc)
    (id rev : w64) (evm : List mvcc.EvM) : Persistent (mvcc.complW γw ql CS covl id rev evm)

theorem mvcc.evLog_of_cert (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (L : mvcc.Log) (hrb : receiptBound GF ≤ 2 ^ 48) :
    mvcc.idxCert γ.idx L ∗ mvcc.certOk γ L ∗ mvcc.api.nlLb γ.api L ⊢ mvcc.evLog γ L

def mvcc.regWit (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (l : List mvcc.api.sent.SEv) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(□
      ∀ id rg fg lo,
        ⌜mvcc.api.sent.SEv.reg id rg fg lo ∈ l⌝ -∗ ∃ w fcs, w ↪[γc.reg]□ () ∗ mvcc.watcherFixed w rg fcs ∗ ⌜id = rg.id⌝)

theorem mvcc.isWatchableStore_agree (s1 s2 st : Loc) (γ1 γ2 : mvcc.WsNames) : mvcc.isWatchableStore
    s1 st γ1 ∗ mvcc.isWatchableStore s2 st γ2 ⊢ ⌜s1 = s2⌝

theorem mvcc.findSome_isSome_of_mem {B : GMap Loc mvcc.EventBatch} {l : List (GMap Loc
    mvcc.EventBatch)} {w : Loc} (hB : B ∈ l) (hw : (B !! w).isSome = true) : (List.findSome? (fun x
    => x !! w) l).isSome = true

def mvcc.cmpPerm (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (c : Int) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(mvcc.crevPermAt γ.st c ∗ mvcc.api.crevAtLeast γ.st.api c)

theorem mvcc.doomed_persistent (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (lo : Nat) : Persistent (mvcc.doomed γ lo)

theorem mvcc.wsWatchFrozen_of_frozen (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (σ : mvcc.WsState) : mvcc.crevFrozen γ.st ⊢
    mvcc.wsWatchFrozen γ σ

def mvcc.memberRes (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (q : Qp) (σ : mvcc.WsState) (w : Loc) (st : mvcc.WatcherSt) :
    IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ γw r fcs,
      ⌜σ.M !! w = some γw⌝ ∗
        mvcc.watcherMeta γ w γw ∗
          mvcc.watcherFixed w r fcs ∗
            if σ.live w then
              mvcc.watcherChan γ w γw st.ch ∗
                mvcc.watcherFilters γw fcs ∗
                  ⌜sint.Z r.startRev ≤ ↑γw.lo⌝ ∗
                    ∃ evsw d,
                      ⌜σ.E !! w = some (evsw, d)⌝ ∗
                        monoListAuthOwn γw.evs q.half evsw ∗
                          dghostVar γw.live (DFrac.own q.half) true ∗ mvcc.popFacts γ σ w r γw.lo st evsw d
            else mvcc.cancelled γw)

theorem mvcc.evLog_certOk (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (L : mvcc.Log) : mvcc.evLog γ L ⊢ mvcc.certOk γ L

theorem mvcc.chanRegW_persistent (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (w : Loc) :
    Persistent (mvcc.chanRegW γ γc w)

def mvcc.chanRegAt (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (w : Loc) (n : Nat) : IProp GF :=
  w ↪[γc.regi]□ n

def mvcc.unsyncedAddr [GoSemanticsFunctions] (s : Loc) : Loc :=
  structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.watchableStore
    go!"unsynced" s

def mvcc.evsWf (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (r : mvcc.WatchRange) (lo : Nat) (evs : List mvcc.EvM) (d : Nat) :
    IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ L,
      mvcc.evLog γ.st L ∗
        mvcc.relLb γ (List.length L) ∗
          ⌜d ≤ List.length L ∨ d ≤ lo⌝ ∗
            (⌜evs = mvcc.watchEvents L r lo d⌝ ∨
              mvcc.doomed γ lo ∗ ⌜(evs ≠ [] → lo < d) ∧ ∀ (ev : mvcc.EvM), ev ∈ evs → mvcc.evPos ev⌝))

theorem mvcc.watcherFilters_ok (γw : mvcc.WatcherNames) (fcs : GoSlice) : mvcc.watcherFilters γw fcs
    ⊢ mvcc.filtersOk fcs

def mvcc.Deliv.sent (d : mvcc.Deliv) : Bool :=
  d.fst.isEmpty || !d.snd.isEmpty

def mvcc.watchStoreInv (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (q : Qp) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ σ,
      mvcc.watchStoreBody s γ q σ ∗
        mvcc.relAuth γ q σ.Lmu ∗ mvcc.wsFields s γ q ∗ ⌜σ.settled ∧ σ.srBelow (List.length σ.Lmu) ∧ σ.unsRst⌝)

theorem mvcc.cmpPerm_persistent (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (c : Int) : Persistent (mvcc.cmpPerm γ c)

def mvcc.watchStoreBody (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (q : Qp) (σ : mvcc.WsState) : IProp GF :=
  iprop("Hσ" ∷ ghostVar γ.wst q σ ∗
      "Hwlog" ∷ mvcc.wlogQ γ q σ.Lmu ∗
        "#Hcert" ∷ mvcc.idxCert γ.st.idx σ.Lmu ∗
          "#Hwfz" ∷ mvcc.wsWatchFrozen γ σ ∗
            "Hsynced" ∷ mvcc.ownWatcherGroup (mvcc.syncedAddr s) σ.Ws q ∗
              "Hunsynced" ∷ mvcc.ownWatcherGroup (mvcc.unsyncedAddr s) σ.Wu q ∗
                "Hvf" ∷ typedPointsto (mvcc.victimsAddr s) σ.vs (DFrac.own q) ∗
                  "Hvs" ∷ ownSlice σ.vs σ.vbs (DFrac.own q) ∗
                    "Hvcap" ∷ ownSliceCap GoMap σ.vs (DFrac.own q) ∗
                      "%Hvlen" ∷ ⌜σ.vbs.length = σ.VB.length⌝ ∗
                        ("Hvbs" ∷ [∗list] x ∈ σ.vbs.zip σ.VB, mvcc.ownWatcherBatch x.fst x.snd q) ∗
                          ("Hst" ∷ [∗map] w ↦ st ∈ σ.ST, mvcc.watcherOwn w st q) ∗
                            ("Hwo" ∷ [∗map] w ↦ st ∈ σ.Wo, mvcc.watcherOwn w st q.half) ∗
                              "Hmeta" ∷ ghostMapAuth γ.wmeta q σ.M ∗
                                "Hwt" ∷ mvcc.watchBudget γ q σ.M ∗
                                  ("#Hmfix" ∷ [∗map] w ↦ _γw ∈ σ.M, iprop(∃ r fcs, mvcc.watcherFixed w r fcs)) ∗
                                    ("Hmem" ∷ [∗map] w ↦ st ∈ σ.ST, mvcc.memberRes γ q σ w st) ∗
                                      ("#Hout" ∷ [∗map] w ↦ st ∈ σ.Wo, mvcc.outRes γ σ w st) ∗ "%Hok" ∷ ⌜mvcc.WsOk σ⌝)

def mvcc.instDecidableLive (σ : mvcc.WsState) (w : Loc) : Decidable (σ.live w) :=
  id inferInstance

theorem mvcc.wsWatchFrozen_any (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (σ : mvcc.WsState) : ⊢ mvcc.wsWatchFrozen γ σ

theorem mvcc.revMuInv_open_ws (s st : Loc) (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (q : Qp) : typedPointsto
    (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.watchableStore go!"store" s) st
    DFrac.discard ∗ mvcc.revMuInv st γ.st q ∗ mvcc.wsFields s γ 1 ⊢ (∃ γp, mvcc.revMuBody st γ.st γp
    q ∗ mvcc.revMuTok γ.st γp q) ∗ mvcc.wsFields s γ 1

def mvcc.rsnW (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (w : Loc) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ r fcs, mvcc.watcherFixed w r fcs ∗ mvcc.chanCancelTok γc r.id)

theorem mvcc.respRev_cmpPerm (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (pre : List mvcc.RespM) (y : mvcc.RespM) :
    mvcc.respRev γ pre y ⊢ mvcc.cmpPermOf γ y

theorem mvcc.isWatchTxnWrite_leaseDel (tw s st : Loc) (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (trace : Loc) (ilog :
    mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) (puts deletes putSize : w64) (crev : Int) :
    mvcc.isWatchTxnWrite tw s st γ trace ilog pend puts deletes putSize crev ⊢ ∃ bt, mvcc.storeBt
    γ.st bt ∗ ∀ b key k dq r Φ, typedPointsto (globalAddr
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.Lease) b DFrac.discard -∗ ownSlice key k dq -∗
    mvcc.storeRb γ.st r -∗ ▷ (mvcc.isWatchTxnWrite tw s st γ trace ilog pend puts deletes putSize
    crev true -∗ ownSlice key k dq -∗ mvcc.storeRb γ.st (mvcc.rbDel r mvcc.leaseName k) -∗ Φ
    (intoVal ())) -∗ WP (((intoVal (methods bt.ty go!"UnsafeDelete" bt.v)) (intoVal b)) (intoVal
    key)) {{ Φ }}

def mvcc.chanRegFact (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (w : Loc) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ rr fcs, mvcc.watcherFixed w rr fcs ∗ mvcc.chanIdAssigned γc rr.id w ∗ ⌜rr.id ≠ W64 (-1)⌝)

def mvcc.watchReader (s st : Loc) (γ : mvcc.WsNames) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(mvcc.storeReader st γ.st ∗ sync.ownRWMutex (mvcc.wsMuAddr s) (mvcc.watchStoreInv s γ))

def mvcc.delivsCut (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (r : mvcc.WatchRange) (lo : Nat) (D : List mvcc.Deliv) : IProp
    GF :=
  iprop(□ ∀ k, ⌜k ≤ D.length⌝ -∗ ∃ d', mvcc.evsWf γ r lo (List.map Prod.fst (List.take k D)).flatten d')

def mvcc.relLb (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (n : Nat) : IProp GF :=
  monoNatLbOwn γ.rel n

theorem mvcc.isWatchableStore_rb (s st : Loc) (γ : mvcc.WsNames) : mvcc.isWatchableStore s st γ ⊢
    ⌜receiptBound GF ≤ 2 ^ 48⌝

def mvcc.cancelled (γw : mvcc.WatcherNames) : IProp GF :=
  dghostVar γw.live DFrac.discard false

theorem mvcc.cov_list (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (closed : Bool) (sent : List
    mvcc.RespM) (L : List Loc) (rev : w64) (q : Qp) (cs : List mvcc.CovArg) : (mvcc.covPre γ γc rev
    cs ∗ mvcc.covAuth q cs ∗ ghostMapAuth γc.reg 1 (mvcc.regMap L) ∗ [∗list] w ∈ L, mvcc.chanWatcher
    γ γc closed sent w) ⊢ mvcc.covAuth q cs ∗ ghostMapAuth γc.reg 1 (mvcc.regMap L) ∗ ([∗list] w ∈
    L, mvcc.chanWatcher γ γc closed sent w) ∗ □ [∗list] c ∈ cs, mvcc.covFact γ γc sent c.w rev

theorem mvcc.memberRes_congr (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (q : Qp) (σ σ' : mvcc.WsState) (w : Loc) (st :
    mvcc.WatcherSt) (hM : σ'.M = σ.M) (hWs : (σ'.Ws !! w).isSome = (σ.Ws !! w).isSome) (hWu : (σ'.Wu
    !! w).isSome = (σ.Wu !! w).isSome) (hV : σ'.victimOf w = σ.victimOf w) (hE : σ'.E !! w = σ.E !!
    w) (hST : σ'.ST !! w = σ.ST !! w) : mvcc.memberRes γ q σ w st ⊢ mvcc.memberRes γ q σ' w st

theorem mvcc.sentAuth_idx (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (sent : List mvcc.RespM) (L
    : List Loc) : mvcc.sentAuth γ γc sent L ⊢ ⌜mvcc.idxOk sent⌝

theorem mvcc.WsOk.ws_size {σ : mvcc.WsState} (h : mvcc.WsOk σ) : σ.Ws.size ≤ σ.M.size

def mvcc.watchRdPoolN : Namespace :=
  (nroot.@"mvcc").@"watchRdPool"

theorem mvcc.outRes_persistent (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (σ : mvcc.WsState) (w : Loc) (st : mvcc.WatcherSt)
    : Persistent (mvcc.outRes γ σ w st)

structure mvcc.WsState : Type where
  Lmu : mvcc.Log
  Ws : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange
  Wu : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange
  ST : GMap Loc mvcc.WatcherSt
  Wo : GMap Loc mvcc.WatcherSt
  M : GMap Loc mvcc.WatcherNames
  E : GMap Loc (List mvcc.EvM × Nat)
  vs : GoSlice
  vbs : List GoMap
  VB : List (GMap Loc mvcc.EventBatch)

def mvcc.watchTok (γ : mvcc.WsNames) : IProp GF :=
  ownToks γ.wt 1

def mvcc.watchResponseCountable : Pos.Countable go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.WatchResponse
    :=
  Pos.Countable.ofInjective (fun r => Pos.Countable.encode (r.WatchID', r.Events', r.Revision', r.CompactRevision')) ⋯

theorem mvcc.revApi_persistent (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (rev : w64) : Persistent (mvcc.revApi γ rev)

def mvcc.wsFields (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (q : Qp) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ st,
      typedPointsto
          (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.watchableStore go!"store" s) st
          DFrac.discard ∗
        mvcc.fieldShare st γ.st q.half.half ∗ ghostVar γ.st.wsd q ())

theorem mvcc.chanApi_sentLb (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (ch : Loc) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (sent recv :
    List mvcc.RespM) (n : Nat) : mvcc.chanApi γ ch γc sent recv ∗ mvcc.api.wsSentLbI (mvcc.wsAbsOf γ
    ch γc) n ⊢ mvcc.chanApi γ ch γc sent recv ∗ ⌜n ≤ sent.length⌝

theorem mvcc.revLbOf_of (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (pre : List mvcc.RespM) (y : mvcc.RespM) : mvcc.respRev γ
    pre y ⊢ mvcc.revLbOf γ y

def mvcc.respCompl (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (x : mvcc.RespM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜x.id ≠ W64 (-1)⌝ ∨ (□ ∀ w, ⌜w ∈ x.regs⌝ -∗ ⌜w ∈ x.cov⌝ ∨ mvcc.rsnW γc w) ∗ ⌜1 ≤ sint.Z x.rev ∧ x.evs = []⌝)

theorem mvcc.wsFields_fractional (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.WsNames) : Fractional (mvcc.wsFields s γ)

theorem mvcc.isWatchableStore_noCompactor (s st : Loc) (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (h : γ.st.cm = false) :
    mvcc.isWatchableStore s st γ ⊢ mvcc.noCompactor γ.st

theorem mvcc.rdIs_persistent (rd : GoFunc) (s st : Loc) (γ : mvcc.WsNames) : Persistent (mvcc.rdIs
    rd s st γ)

theorem mvcc.watchTokPool_persistent (γ : mvcc.WsNames) : Persistent (mvcc.watchTokPool γ)

theorem mvcc.evLog_nlLb (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (L : mvcc.Log) : mvcc.evLog γ L ⊢ mvcc.api.nlLb γ.api
    L

structure mvcc.CovArg : Type where
  w : Loc
  γw : mvcc.WatcherNames
  r : mvcc.WatchRange
  fcs : GoSlice
  evsw : List mvcc.EvM
  d : Nat

theorem mvcc.isWatchTxnWrite_bt (tw s st : Loc) (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (trace : Loc) (ilog : mvcc.Log)
    (pend : List mvcc.Change) (puts deletes putSize : w64) (crev : Int) (ld : Bool) :
    mvcc.isWatchTxnWrite tw s st γ trace ilog pend puts deletes putSize crev ld ⊢
    mvcc.isWatchTxnWrite tw s st γ trace ilog pend puts deletes putSize crev ld ∗ ∃ bt, mvcc.storeBt
    γ.st bt

theorem mvcc.regWit_nil (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) : ⊢ mvcc.regWit γc []

def mvcc.notifiedLent (γ : mvcc.WsNames) : Option (Qp × mvcc.Log) → IProp GF :=
  match x✝ with
  | some (q, L) => iprop(monoListAuthOwn γ.wlog q L ∗ ⌜L ≠ []⌝)
  | none => iprop(True)

def mvcc.regMap (L : List Loc) : GMap Loc Unit :=
  List.foldr (fun w m => <[w := ()]>m) ∅ L

theorem mvcc.chanSentLb_stream (γo : mvcc.WsStreamNames) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (l : List
    mvcc.RespM) (h : γo.sentl = γc.sentl) : mvcc.chanSentLb γc l ⊣⊢ mvcc.streamSentLb γo l

def mvcc.wBudget (L : mvcc.Log) : Nat :=
  2 ^ 63 - 3 - List.length L

def mvcc.WsState.live (σ : mvcc.WsState) (w : Loc) : Prop :=
  (σ.Ws !! w).isSome = true ∨
    (σ.Wu !! w).isSome = true ∨
      (σ.victimOf w).isSome = true ∨ Option.any (fun st => st.compacted && st.ch != null) (σ.ST !! w) = true

def mvcc.idxOk (sent : List mvcc.RespM) : Prop :=
  ∀ (k : Nat) (x : mvcc.RespM), sent[k]? = some x → x.idx = k

theorem mvcc.wlog_update (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (L L' : mvcc.Log) (h : L <+: L') : ⊢ monoListAuthOwn
    γ.wlog 1 L ==∗ monoListAuthOwn γ.wlog 1 L'

theorem mvcc.filterSpec_persistent (f : GoFunc) (p : mvcc.EvM → Bool) : Persistent (mvcc.filterSpec
    f p)

def mvcc.popFacts (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (σ : mvcc.WsState) (w : Loc) (r : mvcc.WatchRange) (lo : Nat)
    (st : mvcc.WatcherSt) (evsw : List mvcc.EvM) (d : Nat) : IProp GF :=
  if (σ.Ws !! w).isSome = true then
    iprop(⌜↑lo ≤ sint.Z st.minRev ∧ sint.Z st.minRev ≤ ↑d⌝ ∗
        mvcc.evsWf γ r lo evsw d ∗ mvcc.evsWf γ r lo evsw (sint.nat st.minRev))
  else
    if (σ.Wu !! w).isSome = true then
      iprop(⌜↑lo ≤ sint.Z st.minRev ∧ d = sint.nat st.minRev⌝ ∗
          mvcc.evsWf γ r lo evsw d ∗
            (∃ Lc, mvcc.idxCert γ.st.idx Lc ∗ ⌜sint.nat st.minRev ≤ max lo (List.length Lc)⌝) ∗
              (⌜st.compacted = true⌝ → ∃ c0, mvcc.crevLb γ.st.idx c0 ∗ ⌜sint.Z st.minRev < c0⌝))
    else
      match σ.victimOf w with
      | some B =>
        iprop(⌜↑lo ≤ sint.Z st.minRev ∧ d = sint.nat st.minRev ∧ mvcc.victimBatchOk lo st B ∧ B.evs ≠ []⌝ ∗
            mvcc.evsWf γ r lo (evsw ++ B.evs) d)
      | none => iprop(True)

theorem mvcc.watchBudget_bound (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (q : Qp) (M : GMap Loc mvcc.WatcherNames) :
    mvcc.watchBudget γ q M ⊢ mvcc.watchBudget γ q M ∗ ⌜M.size + 3 ≤ 2 ^ 63⌝

theorem mvcc.respOk_persistent (r : mvcc.RespM) : Persistent (mvcc.respOk r)

def mvcc.wsSlot (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (q : Qp) (Lmu : mvcc.Log) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(mvcc.api.pndPart γ.st.api q.half.half none ∗ mvcc.api.nlLb γ.st.api Lmu)

theorem mvcc.covPre_persistent (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (rev : w64) (cs : List
    mvcc.CovArg) : Persistent (mvcc.covPre γ γc rev cs)

def mvcc.victimsAddr [GoSemanticsFunctions] (s : Loc) : Loc :=
  structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.watchableStore go!"victims" s

def mvcc.wsWatchFrozen (_γ : mvcc.WsNames) (_σ : mvcc.WsState) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(True)

theorem mvcc.relLb_persistent (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (n : Nat) : Persistent (mvcc.relLb γ n)

theorem mvcc.regMap_lookup (L : List Loc) (w : Loc) : (mvcc.regMap L !! w).isSome = true ↔ w ∈ L

def mvcc.notifiedLb (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (L : mvcc.Log) : IProp GF :=
  monoListLbOwn γ.wlog L

def mvcc.respOk (r : mvcc.RespM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜∀ (ev : mvcc.EvM), ev ∈ r.evs → sint.Z ev.kv.modRev ≤ sint.Z r.rev⌝ ∗
      ∃ rr fcs,
        mvcc.watcherFixed r.w rr fcs ∗
          ⌜(r.evs ≠ [] → r.id = rr.id) ∧
              (r.id = rr.id ∨ r.id = W64 (-1)) ∧
                (r.compactRev ≠ W64 0 → r.evs = [] ∧ r.id = rr.id ∧ r.id ≠ W64 (-1) ∧ r.rev = W64 0)⌝)

theorem mvcc.evsWf_persistent (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (r : mvcc.WatchRange) (lo : Nat) (evs : List
    mvcc.EvM) (d : Nat) : Persistent (mvcc.evsWf γ r lo evs d)

theorem mvcc.cmpPermOf_persistent (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (x : mvcc.RespM) : Persistent (mvcc.cmpPermOf γ
    x)

def mvcc.isWatchTxnWrite (tw s st : Loc) (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (trace : Loc) (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend :
    List mvcc.Change) (puts deletes putSize : w64) (crev : Int) (ld : Bool := false) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ mw,
      "#Htw" ∷
          typedPointsto tw
            {
              TxnWrite' :=
                interface.mkOk go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.metricsTxnWrite.ty.PointerType (intoVal mw),
              s' := s }
            DFrac.discard ∗
        "#Hws" ∷ mvcc.isWatchableStore s st γ ∗
          "Htx" ∷ mvcc.isTxnWrite mw st γ.st trace ilog pend puts deletes putSize crev iprop(True) ld ∗
            "#Hcert" ∷ mvcc.idxCert γ.st.idx ilog)

def mvcc.chanWatcher (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (closed : Bool) (sent : List
    mvcc.RespM) (w : Loc) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ γw r fcs evsw D d,
      mvcc.watcherMeta γ w γw ∗
        ⌜γw.wc = γc⌝ ∗
          ⌜mvcc.startLo r γw.lo⌝ ∗
            mvcc.watcherFixed w r fcs ∗
              monoListAuthOwn γw.evs (Qp.half 1) evsw ∗
                ⌜(List.map Prod.fst D).flatten = evsw ∧
                      List.map mvcc.RespM.evs (List.filter (fun x => decide (x.w = w)) sent) =
                        List.map Prod.snd (List.filter mvcc.Deliv.sent D)⌝ ∗
                  □
                      (([∗list] dl ∈ D,
                          iprop(∃ fs,
                              mvcc.filtersImpl fcs fs ∗
                                mvcc.api.savedFilters γw.fg fs ∗ ⌜dl.snd = mvcc.filtered fs dl.fst⌝)) ∗
                        mvcc.delivsCut γ r γw.lo D) ∗
                    mvcc.evsWf γ r γw.lo evsw d ∗
                      (⌜closed = false⌝ ∗ dghostVar γw.live (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1)) true ∨ mvcc.cancelled γw))

theorem mvcc.delivsCut_persistent (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (r : mvcc.WatchRange) (lo : Nat) (D : List
    mvcc.Deliv) : Persistent (mvcc.delivsCut γ r lo D)

def mvcc.watchConsumer (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (received : List mvcc.RespM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(ghostVar γc.recv (Qp.half 1) received ∗ ghostVar γc.arcv (Qp.half 1) (List.map mvcc.RespM.toW received))

theorem mvcc.wsOk_M_ne_of_Wu (σ : mvcc.WsState) (h : mvcc.WsOk σ) (w : Loc) (hw : (σ.Wu !! w).isSome
    = true) : σ.M ≠ ∅

theorem mvcc.chan_recvEvs (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (sent : List mvcc.RespM) (L : List Loc) (w :
    Loc) (r : mvcc.WatchRange) (fcs : GoSlice) (hL : ∀ (x : mvcc.RespM), x ∈ sent → x.w ∈ L) (hw : w
    ∈ L) (hid : r.id ≠ W64 (-1)) : (□ [∗list] x ∈ sent, mvcc.respOk x) ∗ (□ [∗list] w' ∈ L,
    mvcc.chanRegFact γc w') ∗ mvcc.watcherFixed w r fcs ⊢ ⌜mvcc.api.recvEvs (List.map mvcc.RespM.toW
    sent) r.id = (List.map mvcc.RespM.evs (List.filter (fun x => decide (x.w = w)) sent)).flatten⌝

theorem mvcc.complW_facts (γw : mvcc.WatcherNames) (ql : Qp) (CS : IProp GF) (L covl : List Loc) (id
    rid rev : w64) (evm : List mvcc.EvM) (hrid : rid ≠ W64 (-1)) : CS ∗ (⌜id = rid⌝ ∨ ⌜id = W64
    (-1)⌝ ∗ mvcc.complW γw ql CS covl id rev evm) ∗ ghostVar γw.wc.regl (Qp.half 1) L ∗ dghostVar
    γw.live (DFrac.own ql) true ⊢ CS ∗ ghostVar γw.wc.regl (Qp.half 1) L ∗ dghostVar γw.live
    (DFrac.own ql) true ∗ (⌜id = W64 (-1)⌝ → mvcc.progFact γw.wc.prog) ∗ (⌜id ≠ W64 (-1)⌝ ∨ (□ ∀ w,
    ⌜w ∈ L⌝ -∗ ⌜w ∈ covl⌝ ∨ mvcc.rsnW γw.wc w) ∗ ⌜1 ≤ sint.Z rev ∧ evm = []⌝)

def mvcc.chanApi (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (ch : Loc) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (sent recv : List
    mvcc.RespM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ l dec,
      mvcc.api.chanApiAt (mvcc.wsAbsOf γ ch γc) l dec (List.map mvcc.RespM.toW recv) ∗
        ⌜mvcc.api.sent.sendsOf l = List.map mvcc.RespM.toW sent⌝ ∗ mvcc.regWit γc l)

def mvcc.syncedAddr [GoSemanticsFunctions] (s : Loc) : Loc :=
  structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.watchableStore go!"synced" s

theorem mvcc.watchNoDup_persistent (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : Persistent (mvcc.watchNoDup γ)

def mvcc.regCb (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (ch : GoChan) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (rg : mvcc.WatchRange)
    (fs : List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) (Back : Loc → IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∀ w fg lo l dec recv C c q q2,
      ⌜w ≠ null ∧ lo = if rg.startRev = W64 0 then List.length C else (sint.Z rg.startRev).toNat⌝ -∗
        mvcc.api.savedFilters fg fs -∗
          mvcc.api.chanApiAt (mvcc.wsAbsOf γ ch γc) l dec recv -∗
            mvcc.api.revMuAbs γ.st.api q C c -∗
              mvcc.api.pndPart γ.st.api q2 none ={⊤ \ ↑mvcc.watchN}=∗
                ∃ dec',
                  mvcc.chanIdAssigned γc rg.id w ∗
                    Back w ∗
                      mvcc.api.chanApiAt (mvcc.wsAbsOf γ ch γc) (l ++ [mvcc.api.sent.SEv.reg rg.id rg fg lo]) dec' recv ∗
                        mvcc.api.revMuAbs γ.st.api q C c ∗ mvcc.api.pndPart γ.st.api q2 none)

theorem mvcc.wsWatchFrozen_mono (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (σ σ' : mvcc.WsState) (_h : σ.M = ∅ → σ'.M = ∅) :
    mvcc.wsWatchFrozen γ σ ⊢ mvcc.wsWatchFrozen γ σ'

theorem mvcc.respCov_cmpPerm (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (pre : List mvcc.RespM)
    (x : mvcc.RespM) : mvcc.respCov γ γc pre x ⊢ mvcc.cmpPermOf γ x

theorem mvcc.evLog_cmp (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (L L' : mvcc.Log) : ⊢ mvcc.evLog γ L -∗ mvcc.evLog γ L'
    -∗ ⌜L <+: L' ∨ L' <+: L⌝

def mvcc.watcherMeta (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (w : Loc) (γw : mvcc.WatcherNames) : IProp GF :=
  w ↪[γ.wmeta]□ γw

theorem mvcc.revLbOf_persistent (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (y : mvcc.RespM) : Persistent (mvcc.revLbOf γ y)

def mvcc.watchChanInv (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (ch : Loc) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ s sent recv vs L,
      "Hch" ∷ ownChan γc.ch go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.WatchResponse s ∗
        "Hrecv" ∷ ghostVar γc.recv (Qp.half 1) recv ∗
          "%Hpre" ∷ ⌜recv <+: sent⌝ ∗
            "%Hinfl" ∷ ⌜chanInflight s = some vs⌝ ∗
              "#Hvs" ∷ mvcc.respsIs vs (List.drop recv.length sent) ∗
                ("#Hok" ∷ □ [∗list] r ∈ sent, mvcc.respOk r) ∗
                  "Hregl" ∷ ghostVar γc.regl (Qp.half 1) L ∗
                    ("Hcl" ∷ if chanIsClosed s = true then ghostVar γc.regl (Qp.half 1) L else True) ∗
                      "Hreg" ∷ ghostMapAuth γc.reg 1 (mvcc.regMap L) ∗
                        "%Hnd" ∷ ⌜L.Nodup ∧ ∀ (x : mvcc.RespM), x ∈ sent → x.w ∈ L⌝ ∗
                          ("#Hrf" ∷ □ [∗list] w ∈ L, mvcc.chanRegFact γc w) ∗
                            ("#Hrt" ∷ □ [∗list] w ∈ L, mvcc.chanRegW γ γc w) ∗
                              ("#Hpf" ∷ □ [∗list] r ∈ sent, iprop(⌜r.id = W64 (-1)⌝ → mvcc.progFact γc.prog)) ∗
                                "Hsentl" ∷ mvcc.sentAuth γ γc sent L ∗
                                  ("Hws" ∷ [∗list] w ∈ L, mvcc.chanWatcher γ γc (chanIsClosed s) sent w) ∗
                                    "Hapi" ∷ mvcc.chanApi γ ch γc sent recv)

theorem mvcc.evsWf_doomed (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (r : mvcc.WatchRange) (lo : Nat) (evs : List mvcc.EvM)
    (d : Nat) (L : mvcc.Log) (h : d ≤ List.length L ∨ d ≤ lo) (hne : evs ≠ [] → lo < d) (hpos : ∀
    (ev : mvcc.EvM), ev ∈ evs → mvcc.evPos ev) : mvcc.evLog γ.st L ∗ mvcc.relLb γ (List.length L) ∗
    mvcc.doomed γ lo ⊢ mvcc.evsWf γ r lo evs d

theorem mvcc.exactOr_mono (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (lo : Nat) {P Q : Prop} (h : P → Q) : ⌜P⌝ ∨ mvcc.doomed
    γ lo ⊢ ⌜Q⌝ ∨ mvcc.doomed γ lo

def mvcc.WsState.srBelow (σ : mvcc.WsState) (N : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ (w : Loc) (γw : mvcc.WatcherNames), σ.M !! w = some γw → γw.now = true → γw.lo ≤ N

def mvcc.covAuth (q : Qp) (cs : List mvcc.CovArg) : IProp GF :=
  [∗list] c ∈ cs, monoListAuthOwn c.γw.evs q c.evsw

theorem mvcc.recvEvs_toW (sent : List mvcc.RespM) (id : w64) (w : Loc) (h1 : ∀ (x : mvcc.RespM), x ∈
    sent → x.id = id → x.w = w) (h2 : ∀ (x : mvcc.RespM), x ∈ sent → x.w = w → x.id = id ∨ x.evs =
    []) : mvcc.api.recvEvs (List.map mvcc.RespM.toW sent) id = (List.map mvcc.RespM.evs (List.filter
    (fun x => decide (x.w = w)) sent)).flatten
